issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. There is no file or network access, no pasted coordinates and no use of labels. All randomness still comes from the seeded rng.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. Guided restarts now start from 0.97 * best[1], where best[1] is the repaired, valid radii array of shape (n,). They also use a smaller perturbation sd (0.02 instead of 0.03). _repair still runs after every SLSQP call, so the final packing is still checked and shrunk if needed. The diff changes two things at once, so the result cannot be credited to either one alone.

The numbers match the provisional decision. The candidate loss is -2.937 against the incumbent's -2.9365, a difference of -0.0005 in the candidate's favour. With 1 run on each side and a noise sd of 0.0034, the sd of the difference is 0.0034*sqrt(2) ≈ 0.0048, which gives z ≈ 0.10. The harness's 0.107 most likely comes from unrounded values. This is well below any significance threshold, so rejecting is correct.

Both sides are a single run (n=1), so the comparison has very little power. The candidate's 2.937 is at the best published value (≈2.9370), but the incumbent is already at 2.9365, so that alone is not suspicious.
